items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: "Hey, Mister Dishrag! This cat told me... You know, Roy is my boy, man

ctx.x: funny job, too, because this cat here wwas a very prejudiced cat. He didn't allow the band to come out behind the bandstand. No, you had to go down through a trap door down to the basement. You would go out the back door to the bus station(?). Them bars wasn't too cool in those days either, you know.

But I had a friend who was a pretty rough character, you know. In fact, he took a gun off a cat in there one night. This cat was kind of scary(?). So he came in to see me, because he used to me when I was in the Deuces, you know... He come in to see me one night, and he said, "Come on and have a drink." I said, "This cat don't let me (?) to have a drink." "What?" So he called him, "Hey, Mister Dishrag! This cat told me... You know, Roy is my boy, man, and I want him out here to drink with me." Oh yeah, of…
I had the same thing happen when Artie Shaw came down; I had a drink with him, too.
